lines: My toes, starving for a last chance,
I ran through this night sky, dancing as it remained.
An ordinary stance won’t bend.
Stars are the longing of jewels.
Floating tears and sweat are the remnants of blood.
If I can only swim inside my eyes, it’s a performance.
But the stage won’t let me escape.
Forever yearning.
I burn with yearning.
I've never seen such a liar
Born with a bottomless pit.
This lie is love
And this lie is a gift to the world
Remember who you lived with.
I’ll give it because I stake my life, ah.
Did you give me time?
If I fulfill all wishes, ah, if I can achieve them, ah.
I want to see you.
Make a wish upon the stars.
Since we can’t return, should we cherish it?
If you don’t begin, you can call it high.
The day that becomes easy never comes first.
Sad light gathers within the days.
It’s bottomless, even from birth.
This lie is love
And this lie is a gift to the world
I forgot who I lived for!
If my life returns to you, if it reaches you, ah.
I don’t care what becomes of me, ah.
It seems nothing will be fulfilled.
If it can’t be fulfilled, I want to become you.
Stars shatter and shine.
I’ll give it because I stake my life, ah.
Did you give me time?
If I fulfill all wishes, ah, if I can achieve them, ah.
I want to see you.
Make a wish upon the stars.
Come, children of the stars, sleep well.
Your brilliance will not dull, if it’s you.
Come, children of the stars, aim well.
If it’s you, you won’t allow a flicker.
